name: Wind Power
description: After a wind move is activated that affects this pokemon, the number of damage dice used for its next electric-type attack doubles. Wind moves include Aeroblast, Air Cutter, Bleakwind Storm, Blizzard, Fairy Wind, Gust, Heat Wave, Hurricane, Icy Wind, Petal Blizzard, Sandsear Storm, Sandstorm, Springtide Storm, Tailwind, Twister, Whirlwind, and Wildbolt Storm.
